_about: Round 32 (Robert: 'companions and pets grown up'). Companions fight in a STYLE you choose, carry GEAR you give them, level with what they do, and can be knocked down (they're back after a while, or when you rest). Familiars EVOLVE through stages as the bond deepens; the TAMING skill (fed animals, finds, bites) opens a tree of perks, one choice per tier. Your HOME grows from Elder Mo's plot into a COMPOUND, stage by stage, and a compound looks after your companion and familiar while you're away.

striker.name: Striker
striker.desc: Goes after whatever's nearest and hits hardest.

guard.name: Guard
guard.desc: Keeps your shoulder. Steps into blows meant for you, half the time.

scout.name: Scout
scout.desc: Fights only what comes close. Turns things up as you walk, and spots what's hidden.

stages.title: grown
stages.told: %s has grown. The bones are heavier, the eyes steadier; it stands between you and things now, and bites.

stages.title: fierce
stages.told: %s is fierce now -- a beast the deep would be proud of. Its gifts to you have grown with it.

stages.title: spirit beast
stages.told: %s is a spirit beast. Something of the deep's light lives in it; what it gives you, it gives twice over.

a.name: Keen Nose
a.desc: Your familiar turns things up half again as often.

b.name: Sharp Fangs
b.desc: Its bites hurt half again as much.

a.name: Thick Hide
a.desc: What it gives you grows by a third more.

b.name: Quick Paws
b.desc: It finds faster, and senses further (+3).

a.name: Pack Bond
a.desc: When it bites, you mend a little (2% of your life).

b.name: Wild Call
b.desc: Animals come to trust you in half the feedings; the bond grows half again as fast.

stages.name: Elder Mo's plot
stages.desc: A tent, a garden, a bench, a chest and a bed.

stages.name: a cottage
stages.desc: Walls and a roof instead of a tent. A night here mends more than your body: the well-rested hour is twice as long, and the chest holds twice the stacks.

stages.name: a courtyard
stages.desc: A fenced yard with lanterns and a cultivation stone of your own: sit and cultivate at home at the shrine's rate. The bench works a second order at once.

stages.name: a compound
stages.desc: Quarters for your companion and a kennel for your familiar. While you're away, your companion trains (experience by the hour) and your familiar's bond deepens. A wall around it all.
